prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.6 °C (69% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.8 °C (51% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.2 °C (59% above healthy). Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: severe lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.70 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.57 s (3% above healthy). Prolonged pressure rise time and marked switching lag between pressure lines point to severe directional valve response lag.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 757 W·min/l (98% above healthy); FS1 mean volume flow 3.43 l/min (48% below healthy). No internal bypassing detected; volumetric efficiency is optimal.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 57.1 bar (22% above healthy). Pressure buffering is largely ineffective due to compromised pre-charge pressure in the accumulator.
